title: 牛油果信号引发Chipotle召回辣椒
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So the jalapenos had been linked by public health authorities to some salmonella cases.
segments.zh: 公共卫生部门已将辣椒与一些沙门氏菌病例联系起来。

segments.en: I should say, you know, right off the bat for yours and everyone's sort of peace of mind that Chipotle pulled the jalapenos pretty quickly. And health authorities have said that
segments.zh: 首先，为了让您和大家放心，Chipotle很快撤下了辣椒。卫生部门也表示，

segments.en: they don't have ongoing concerns about people eating at the restaurants. But I think what really stands out here, and I can share more if you want, is just basically how quickly the company was
segments.zh: 他们不担心在餐厅用餐的人。但我觉得真正突出的是，公司能多快锁定辣椒为元凶。

segments.en: able to really zero it on jalapenos as the culprit here. Did that result in positivity for the stock because I'm looking here a year-to-date down 14%, one year return down about 24%.
segments.zh: 这对股价有利吗？因为今年迄今下跌14%，一年回报率下跌约24%。

segments.en: Look, like some of this information has come out very, you know, slowly over the past week.
segments.zh: 这些信息在过去一周里陆续公布。

segments.en: It's still pretty recent. And so basically last week, we, you know, we're first to report that Chipotle had pulled the jalapenos because of the salmonella outbreak, you know, by then,
segments.zh: 还比较新。上周我们率先报道Chipotle因沙门氏菌撤下辣椒，那时他们已经行动了。

segments.en: you know, they had already done enough few days ago and public health authorities were like, yeah, we don't have ongoing concerns. But of course, like, you know, when headlines like that come out,
segments.zh: 几天后，卫生部门表示没有持续担忧。但这类头条新闻一出，人们会感到不安。

segments.en: you know, people do get spooked. And when we publish that story, the stock dropped as much as 9.7% that day. I mean, it's recovered a little bit. But, you know, sometimes this information takes a little bit
segments.zh: 我们发布报道当天，股价一度下跌9.7%，之后有所回升。但有时信息需要时间传播。

segments.en: to sort of, you know, spread in terms of people and health authorities feeling comfortable saying we don't have any more concerns. Go back to the restaurant basically. Daniela, this is a big topic,
segments.zh: 直到人们和卫生部门放心地说没有更多担忧，才回到餐厅。Daniela，这是个重要话题。
